name: registration-service

dependencies.name: registration-db
dependencies.description: Stores session capacities, registrations and the ordered waitlist.

description: Own deployable for registration, as the requirements demand: it holds session capacity, confirmed seats and the ordered waitlist in its own Postgres, and promotes the next waitlisted person when a seat frees. Called only by the events API; it never calls other components. Does not know events, proposals or roles beyond ids.
